cron-explain.name: Cron Explainer
cron-explain.description: Break a cron expression into plain fields and preview its next run times — on your device.

tips.1: Names work everywhere numbers do — try mon-fri or jan,jul.
tips.3: When both day fields are set, cron fires when either matches.

ui.neverRuns: This expression never fires — the day and month combination doesn't exist.
ui.errorShape: A cron expression needs exactly five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
